steps.what: Verify prescription records and capture clerical filing and letter details
Copy verified fields into filing indexes, prescription record views and standard letters
Compose exceptions, check letters and approve clerical record updates

tasks.design: Configure the pharmacy records application in {OTHER} to reuse verified clerical fields in indexes and standard {DOCS} letters. The aide retains first capture, exceptions and checks; prescription authorisation and clinical changes remain with existing qualified staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying between records, indexes and letter templates can consume clerical time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fields and templates can reuse explicit data without clinical interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect patient identity or a wrong source version can propagate through the paperwork.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve clerical discrepancies and escalate anything that changes clinical meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less copying may leave more time for record accuracy; the aide gains no prescribing authority.

evidence.claim: Native field reuse and standard clerical templates can reduce duplicate copying; this is a model-knowledge design with no digest-supported pharmacy aide time estimate.

assumptions: OTHER means a pharmacy records application. Boundary is clerical records and correspondence preparation, not prescription approval, clinical amendments, dispensing or external disclosure. Existing pharmacist review remains outside and unchanged.

Aide produces verified patient/record ID, source document IDs/versions, date, document type, filing destination, selected prescription reference, permitted clerical field values, template and correspondence purpose in s1's retained35 hours. Qualified staff produce the underlying authorised prescription before this task. Missing identity, field or source conflicts return to manual clerical reconciliation or existing clinical escalation before s2; no free clinical-validity flag exists.
Test native indexes/templates before custom code. Existing linked fields or electronic filing runtime create no additional saving.
Eight focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover mapping/template checks and exceptions; four other-role hours cover approved system configuration, not free clinical work.
research_questions: Does native reuse save time after first capture, patient matching and final clerical checks?

already_counted.description: First capture, exceptions and final clerical checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact clerical update set, patient/source versions and letter text; changes void approval and clinical edits require existing qualified review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gross35 minus8 upkeep net27. Range0-12 allows already linked records or mostly bespoke correspondence at0; repeated standard fields support modest gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Greet customers and help them locate merchandise

tasks.design: Retain the personal greeting and assistance locating merchandise. Existing location information in {OPS_SYSTEM}, where present, supports the aide without replacing the interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: The service includes recognising the request and helping the person navigate the shop.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing layout knowledge already supports this work.
tasks.still_hard: A request for a product can conceal a clinical question outside the aide's remit.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify the request and recognise when qualified advice is needed.
tasks.altitude: Customer-facing service time and authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Recognise when a routine request needs qualified advice

evidence.claim: Greeting and helping customers remain human service; no digest capability establishes a shorter pharmacy merchandise interaction.

assumptions: Boundary is greeting and merchandise location, not drug counselling, sales processing or clinical recommendation.

Customer produces the request during the interaction; aide clarifies product and location within retained100 hours. Existing store staff maintain layout through unchanged operations. No free structured intent or current-location flag is assumed; uncertain location uses manual checking.
Retain native stock/location access where available before custom tools; no new capture duty or automated advice is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because service and tools are unchanged.
research_questions: Which merchandise requests need clarification or a clinical referral?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Personal greeting and merchandise assistance retain time; existing location lookup is not new labour saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Unpack, sort and count incoming merchandise and verify special handling requirements
Label merchandise and place refrigeration or special-handling items appropriately

tasks.design: Retain physical receiving, counting, labelling and appropriate storage. Existing instructions in {DOCS} guide handling, with discrepancies raised through the current pharmacy process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Goods must be physically inspected and moved to the appropriate location.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software capability replaces that physical work.
tasks.still_hard: Packaging, quantities and storage conditions can disagree with delivery documents.
tasks.human_edge: Notice damage or an uncertain storage condition and stop routine handling when needed.
tasks.altitude: Receiving time and handling responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Handle supplies according to their storage requirements

evidence.claim: Physical pharmacy receiving and labelling retain their time; no digest source establishes a relevant robotics or handling saving.

assumptions: Boundary is unpacking, sorting, counting, labelling and special storage, not a separately invented data-entry task.

Supplier provides delivery identifiers and product handling instructions before receipt; aide observes actual items, counts, condition, batch/expiry where required and storage requirements during s1's70 hours. S2 includes physical labels and storage checks. Missing or conflicting handling details use existing manual pharmacist escalation; no free refrigeration-needed or acceptable-condition flag is assumed.
Native instructions and any existing label equipment precede custom code. Automatic label printing does not eliminate physical application or inspection.
Zero incremental upkeep because handling process and tools remain unchanged.
research_questions: How much receiving time is physical inspection and movement rather than separately counted records work?

already_counted.description: Receiving checks, physical labelling and storage

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Physical counting, labels and storage retain time, including special-handling exceptions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain authorised drug information to customers

steps.what: Provide customers information about drug uses, effects or interactions within delegated limits

tasks.design: Retain the conversation and use approved material in {DOCS} within the aide's existing remit. Individual clinical interpretation and uncertain interaction questions follow the current pharmacist referral process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correct wording alone does not establish that information is appropriate for this person's question.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved information supports explanation; no new clinical decision tool is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Customers may omit relevant details or misunderstand general information as individual advice.
tasks.human_edge: Check understanding and recognise when the question requires qualified clinical judgement.
tasks.altitude: Conversation time and the aide's clinical authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain authorised information and recognise clinical escalation needs

evidence.claim: Drug-information explanation retains human clarification and existing qualified escalation; clinical scribe capabilities in the digest do not establish shorter counselling conversations.

assumptions: Boundary is information the aide is already permitted to explain, not independent drug selection, prescribing or interaction assessment. Existing pharmacist advice is outside and unchanged; no new referral workload is introduced.

Customer produces the question during the interaction; aide clarifies exact product and request, checks the current approved source/version and understanding within retained100 hours. Pharmacist supplies any required individual instruction through existing practice before the aide conveys it. No free safe-to-advise or no-interaction flag is assumed; missing clinical context prompts existing qualified escalation.
Native approved-reference access precedes custom tools; no generative clinical answer is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because conversation, sources and escalation are unchanged.
unknowns: Existing approved references and pharmacist workflow
research_questions: Which customer questions can the aide already explain, and which require pharmacist judgement?

already_counted.description: Clarification, reference checking, explanation and understanding checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Customer clarification and explanation retain time; no new clinical judgement is delegated to software.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Duplicate clerical copying may shrink while customer service, physical receiving and authorised information conversations remain human.
reach: Learn record traceability with medical records specialists
Learn clear escalation boundaries with medical assistants
role.ambitious_version: An aide who keeps accurate paperwork and gives clear service within well-understood clinical boundaries.
